method_note: bmoe-cli SIGKILL (rc=137) at ~45k scored tokens / ~2h with both cache-mb 2000 and 0. Corpus split paragraph-aligned mid-file; sequential PPL on halves; combine sum_logprob/n_scored. PPL path already uses non-overlapping n_ctx windows with memory clear.
gate_config_note: cache-mb=0 for PPL only (LMK under cache-mb=2000). Decode campaign gate remains cache-mb 2000. Batch effective=16 under MoE streaming in perplexity().

audit_csv_independent.note: Recomputed on PC from part1+part2 per_token.csv

command:
export PREFIX=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr; export PATH=$PREFIX/bin:$PATH
BIN=~/src/BigMoeOnEdge/build-bmoe/cli/bmoe-cli
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(dirname $BIN)
OUT=~/experiments/results/f5.5/a
# part1
$BIN -m ~/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-IQ2_M.gguf -t 4 -c 4096 --moe-stream --cache-mb 0 --dense-weights anon --overlap --io-threads 4 --ubatch 512 --n-expert-used 8 --ppl-file $OUT/split/mixed_it.part1.txt --ppl-csv $OUT/split/part1.per_token.csv
# part2
$BIN -m ~/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-IQ2_M.gguf -t 4 -c 4096 --moe-stream --cache-mb 0 --dense-weights anon --overlap --io-threads 4 --ubatch 512 --n-expert-used 8 --ppl-file $OUT/split/mixed_it.part2.txt --ppl-csv $OUT/split/part2.per_token.csv
# combine: ppl=exp(-(s1+s2)/(n1+n2))
notes: SIGKILL rc=137 at ~45k tokens forced split-2-halves workaround
~5.6 tok/s charged (not a campaign speed metric)
Deterministic gate: --temp 0 for regression; PPL is teacher-forced
